text:
Rachel - CS: Heads-up, Lightspeed (customer) reporting embedding p99 spike since ~03:15 UTC. Their production batch job is hitting 2.5x latency and intermittent 503s. Marked P1 — CS needs eng ownership + ETA.
Alex P.: on it — can you paste sample trace IDs or a short stack of logs? need the last 1h tail.
Rachel - CS: sample traces: trace-9a1, trace-9a2. Uploaded stripped logs to the support bucket (internal link). Customer asked for a temporary workaround while we investigate.
Maya S.: quick read: pool-17 GPUs show memory pressure and KV cache misses spiking around 03:10. Looks like cache churn + batching mismatch, leads to stopwatch tail.
Simon (oncall): I see queue backlog + autoscaler thrash on pool-17. Two immediate mitigations: 1) reduce `max_batch_tokens` to 2048, 2) scale pool by +2 nodes. I can apply throttling now if we agree.
Jen L.: I'll own the scale. prepping `kubectl scale ds/pool-17 --replicas=5 -n inference` and ping infra for burst quota.
Kevin M.: FYI there's a fix in PR #5483 for a KV lock hotspot we saw in staging. If we can flip an eager-evict flag now it'll likely reduce tail without code rollout. Link: https://git.redwood/pr/5483
Alex P.: safest path: toggle runtime config first, watch, then merge PR for a durable fix.
Simon (oncall): agreed. Runtime toggle command: `kubectl set env ds/pool-17 KV_EAGER_EVICT=true -n inference`. That should be a low-risk change.
Jen L.: applying env now and will restart pods gradually: `kubectl rollout restart ds/pool-17 -n inference --timeout=5m` — doing a canary (3/5 pods) first.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for ds/pool-17 (3/5 pods). Check logs: https://deploys.redwood/rollouts/xyz :eyes:
Maya S.: canary observation: p99 on canary pods dropped ~30% vs baseline. Early positive signal.
Kevin M.: still pushing for PR review after stabilization. @Alex P. @Maya S. please review PR #5483 when you can.
Rachel - CS: Lightspeed replied: "appreciate the quick response — can you give us a 2hr stability window before we resume heavy batches?" I'll hold their running jobs.
Alex P.: starting PR review now, aiming to merge in ~30m if no blockers. After merge, plan full rollout +1h.
Simon (oncall): consensus and commitments: Jen scales +2 nodes now and toggles KV_EAGER_EVICT (done, canary in flight). Kevin drives PR -> merge. Alex/Maya review and monitor metrics. Rachel to keep customer updates. We'll monitor for 2h. Owners pinned in thread. :thumbsup:
Rachel - CS: noted. I'll update Lightspeed and will post an update in 15m or sooner on any alerts.
